description: The epoch a controller takes for its own frames in a game (RFC 0001 Amendment 9, per game key, and Amendment 23's item 5 for a lost record, decision SR-29). `table` is the controller's list of (game key, last epoch) records, most recent first, as the store keeps it (by the key's tag); `key` is the game's key, `resuming` says the controller is taking its stored game up again after a restart (not creating or joining a game). The expected result is either `epoch` (exact), `error` (the epochs of that key are used up: 65535), or `lost_range` true (a random epoch inside the top-level `lost_range`: a resumed game with no record of its key may have used any epoch from 1 with it, so it must not start at 1). `floor` (optional, default 0) is the controller's separate record of the highest epoch it ever used with any key (Python setting `tx_epoch_floor`, the same name in the phone's store; decision EP-2): a lost record's epoch is drawn in `[max(lost_range[0], floor + 1), lost_range[1]]`, never below what the controller used before, and the case is an `error` when that range is empty; `lost_lo` and `lost_hi` are the inclusive range a `lost_range` case draws in (decision EPW-1). With no record at all (floor 0) it is the whole `lost_range`. With a floor it is the lower half of what is left above `floor + 1 + lost_margin` (`start = max(lost_range[0], floor + 1 + lost_margin)`, the draw is `[start, start + ceil(room / 2) - 1]` with `room = lost_range[1] - start + 1`): the margin skips the epochs used since a stale floor (a database restored from an old backup), the half-room rule leaves room for later losses. Where the margin does not fit below `lost_range[1]` it gives way (`start = floor + 1`). The Pi also draws far above the floor (a margin of 8192) when its epoch file is missing although it was written before (Python test only: the phone keeps no file). The box draws the same way for its own floor entry (no 'suspect' margin: its floor is never restored from a backup, decision EPW-2). Python (controller/atalaia_controller/store.py next_tx_epoch), Dart (app/lib/controller/controller_radio.dart nextTxEpoch) and the firmware (main/radio/radio_protocol.c atalaia_radio_epoch_lost_bounds, test_radio_protocol.c through tools/protogen.py's firmware/esp32/test/tx_epoch_vectors.h, which takes the cases that draw or are refused, with the floor the larger of the floor entry and the records) must give exactly these.
